meta.price_rule: Only prices printed on the restaurant's own website / official booking page are recorded. Where a venue publishes no price, the field is null and the row is flagged unverified — no estimate is invented.
meta.cost_basis: cost_for_two_usd = lowest published tasting/prix-fixe price per person × 2 (the cheapest way for two adults to eat the full menu). À la carte and supplements are listed separately.
meta.star_note: 'Currently starred' = the live Michelin distinction shown on guide.michelin.com on the verification date. 'Listed in the Guide only' = a Michelin Selected entry with no star; that is a different thing and is kept in a separate table.

starred.name: Eleven Madison Park
starred.hours_note: UNVERIFIED — the official site publishes a ticketing flow, not an hours table; Michelin's detail page has no hours widget for EMP.
starred.cheapest_option: Lounge/bar tasting — $510 for two (FAQ also quotes lounge tables from $225 pp)
starred.policies: All sales final, non-refundable, no rescheduling. Reservations open on the 1st of each month for the following month (e.g. Oct 1 releases all of November) — so a Feb 2027 booking opens 1 Feb 2027. No dress code. Corkage $75/750 ml, max 4 bottles. Gratuity not included.
starred.menu_note: The six-course menu is plant-based; the kitchen confirms allergies/aversions by email before service.

starred.name: Jungsik New York
starred.coords_note: Nominatim returned a Binghamton, NY record for '2 Harrison Street'. Coordinates left blank — do not trust a geocode from that query.
starred.hours_note: UNVERIFIED. jungsik.com publishes an address, a phone number and a Tock link but no hours table; the Michelin detail page has none either. Tock's venue page showed a 17:00–21:30 service window and 15-minute slots on the day it was read, which is a single weekday observation and NOT evidence of which days the room is closed.
starred.booking_note: The Tock listing read on 2026-11-25 showed a 'Jungsik Main Dining Room [November, December 2026]' release — i.e. seatings are released roughly two months at a time, so a February 2027 table may not be on sale yet.
starred.cheapest_option: Signature menu — $670 for two; a $200 pp deposit is taken at booking. Bar seats are à la carte (price not published).
